comparison.objective: Use one rigid bar to push three cartridges uniformly to their stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-handed bar grasp and coordinated multi-object pushing; explicitly not insertion or adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Centers at x=0.312–0.332 m with spread at most 12 mm; no spec versions are present.
comparison.reason: Uniform multi-load positioning is meaningfully different from commissioning a damper.
